host_policy: one named local host, one stable compiler digest across both splits; no second-host generalization claim
split_policy: fit on train programs and witnesses only; serialize model before validation native trials; reject duplicate source or assignment digests and mixed compiler/profile/FRI policy within family

features.raw_rows: sum of all nonzero raw component rows
features.padded_rows: sum of all nonzero padded component rows
features.hash_work: 1 + raw blake_g rows; hash family only

fit: per family and stage, OLS log(program median) versus log(predeclared positive feature), except constant stage uses median of training program medians; PoW gets its own fitted median and empirical trial/median multiplier distribution; generic hash prove time is one opaque stochastic stage
interval: each stage center multiplied by exp(+- maximum leave-one-training-program-out absolute log residual), then by pooled training trial/within-program-median empirical p05/p95 ratios; sum stage endpoints for process wall; descriptive predictive interval, not a confidence interval
selection_policy: automatic lowering remains disabled even if local accuracy gate passes; profile soundness equivalence, additional hosts, and comparison on paired assignments remain required
